reason: At src/sentry/replays/endpoints/project_replay_summarize_breadcrumbs.py, fetch_error_details reads `data.get("timestamp")` from nodestore, which is a float in seconds. gen_request_data then checks it with `< event.get("timestamp", 0)` against rrweb event timestamps, which are in milliseconds, so the check is always true and every error is emitted before the first rrweb event; the new test passes only because it puts both in the same made-up units (patch lines 5831-5873).
